name: MCC
fix_description: In deliver, reducing _rTotal changes the global reflect rate, which creates a discrepancy between the LP pair actual balance and its recorded reserves (since pair may be excluded from reflection). Attacker calls deliver to manipulate the rate, then exploits the balance/reserve mismatch. Fix: exclude LP pair from rate changes, or add reentrancy/same-block protection on deliver + swap combinations.
